extDescription.message: See any page's design values, and match them against your MUI theme — on production sites, not just localhost.

popupToggleInspect.message: Toggle inspect mode on this tab

hintEnableSite.message: For deployed/production sites, not just localhost — grants access and starts inspecting right away.

ctxOpenInEditor.message: Open this element’s source in my editor

hintAllSites.message: For inspecting many sites in a row. Chrome will warn that the extension can "read all your data on all websites" — unavoidable for a tool that inspects any page. Per-site enabling works just as well (no feature difference). Revoke from the same button; already-open tabs need one reload.

permError.message: The permission request didn't go through — close this popup, open it again, and press the button once more.

siteUnavailable.message: This page (non-http/https or unknown URL) can't be enabled.

siteUnknownUrl.message: This tab does not report a URL (a blob: preview, for example). With all-sites access granted, the inspector can still be injected — press the button to try.

siteBlobNeedsAllSites.message: This tab is a blob: preview. Grant "Enable on all sites" above once, then this button injects into it.
siteBlobNeedsAllSites.description: popup: blob: タブで全サイト許可が無いときの理由と解決策 (誤って「http/https 以外」と言わない)

injectError.message: Couldn't start on this page. Reload it and try again.

hintConfigureShortcuts.message: Opens chrome://extensions/shortcuts, where you can assign or change the key for inspect mode. Chrome leaves a shortcut unassigned when another extension already uses the same keys.

inspectOn.message: Inspect ON — hover to inspect, Esc to exit. ⌘/Ctrl+Click: open in editor / Alt+Click: what rendered this / ↑↓: parent/child

inspectOnSafe.message: Inspect ON — React production build: no component names or source jump, but design values and token matching work. Esc to exit

inspectOnNoReact.message: Inspect ON — no React on this page. Design values, CSS variable names and grid checks work. Esc to exit

jumpUnresolved.message: Could not resolve source location (React 19 may need the Babel source plugin)

jumpProd.message: Source jump is unavailable on production builds

sourceMinified.message: bundled output · run a dev build to jump

editorNotOpened.message: Nothing opened — your editor may not be installed, or its URL scheme is not registered.

chainEmpty.message: Nothing to show — this element has no React owner (plain DOM, or a production build with names stripped).

noSourceDom.message: No source location found — not a React dev build, no source annotation attribute (data-source etc.), and no same-origin CSS to open.

renderOn.message: Render viz ON — re-rendered elements flash (blue→red = more frequent) / R: record / toggle again to exit

renderOnNoDev.message: Render viz ON — no dev build detected, timing unavailable (flash only)

treeOn.message: Component tree ON — hover a row to highlight, hover the page to locate it. Esc to close

treeOnSafe.message: Component tree ON — no dev build detected, names are estimated

recordStart.message: Recording — interact to trigger re-renders, press R to stop and see the ranking

statsColsSupported.message: Hover a row for why it re-rendered (state / props / parent)

statsColsUnsupported.message: Production build: render counts and causes are exact, timings need a dev build

statsWastedHint.message: wasted = re-rendered by a parent with identical props → React.memo candidate

statsCopied.message: Report copied — paste it into your AI assistant to start the analysis

statsCopyFail.message: Copy failed — clipboard is unavailable on this page

themeTokensLoaded.message: MUI theme detected — color tokens: {colors} / size tokens: {sizes}
themeTokensLoaded.description: Toast when the MUI theme is auto-extracted (FR-14). {colors}/{sizes} are counts.

treeUnavailableProd.message: Component tree needs a development build — this page is a production build, where React strips component names. Design measurement and token matching still work.

hintEditorUsage.message: While inspecting, ⌘/Ctrl+Click an element to open its source, or use the right-click menu. Resolution order: React dev build source, then a source annotation attribute (works on any framework), then the same-origin CSS file that styles the element. If none applies, the extension explains why and offers copyable search hints. The editor you pick must be installed.

hintPathMappings.message: One per line, from=to, optionally scoped with @ origin (substring match). Needed when the path the browser reports is not the path on your disk — e.g. Next.js reports project-relative paths like /src/app/page.tsx, so map /src=/Users/me/myapp/src @ localhost:3000. The first matching prefix wins.

modeNotEnabledHere.message: Not enabled on this site yet — use "Enable on current site…" above first. (localhost works without this.)

modeNotInspectable.message: This page can't be inspected (not an http/https page).

editorHintsCopied.message: Search hints copied — paste into your editor’s search

hintSourceAttr.message: For non-React pages: if the server annotates elements with a source attribute (value like path:line), the extension opens it. Common conventions (data-v-inspector, data-source, data-inspector-*) are always read; put your own attribute name here.

editorNeedsMapping.message: {path} is a project-relative path, so the editor cannot find it. Open the popup → Advanced → Path mappings and add: {mapping}

editorMappingCopied.message: Copied — paste it into Path mappings and replace the placeholder with your project path

hintRootCandidates.message: Detected from the inspected page. Click to insert a line, then check it points at your project (the extension cannot read your disk, so it cannot verify this).

editorRemoteSource.message: Source is at {path} in that site’s project — not on this computer, so it cannot be opened.

editorTildePath.message: The path mapping contains “~”, which editors do not expand — the open will always fail. In the popup → Advanced → Path mappings, replace ~ with the full absolute path (e.g. /Users/you/…).

editorOpenedViaDevServer.message: Asked the dev server to open it in your editor

panelNoteTruncated.message: Measurement stopped early, so these counts describe part of this page, not the whole page.

panelNoteNoDict.message: No design tokens were found on this page, so nothing could be matched. Off-grid spacing is still detected.

panelStaleTab.message: You switched tabs. These numbers are from the page you measured, not the one you are looking at.

panelStaleNavigation.message: This page navigated after the measurement. These numbers describe the previous page.

panelTargetUnreadable.message: This panel cannot read this page. If it is a normal web page, enable it from the toolbar popup; some pages (browser settings, the Web Store) cannot be inspected at all.

panelFailTimeout.message: The page took too long to measure and the request was given up. Large pages can hit this; try again, or measure a smaller view.

panelFailUnreachable.message: The inspector is not running on this page. Enable this site from the toolbar popup, then reload the page.

panelFailEmpty.message: The page replied but sent no measurement. Reload the page and try again.

panelOpenFailed.message: Could not open the coverage panel. Your Chrome may not support side panels, or the tab could not be resolved — try reopening this popup.

panelCeiling.message: A match means the value equals one of your tokens. It does not mean the design is right. iframes, shadow DOM and hidden elements are out of scope.

panelRateClamped.message: Rounded away from 100% / 0% because some values do differ. All percentages are rounded.

panelLowSampleHint.message: Fewer than 10 values were judged, so this percentage moves a lot with one value.

panelMatchLegend.message: A value counts as matched when it equals one of your tokens. Spacing is also checked against the {grid}px grid.

panelOverallNote.message: color and font size exist on every element, so the overall figure is pulled toward those two

panelNothingJudged.message: Nothing could be judged, so there is nothing to rank yet.

panelNoOffenders.message: No value missed your tokens. Nothing to rank.

panelNoSpacing.message: No spacing value was measured on this page.

panelAllOnGrid.message: No spacing value is both off your tokens and off the {grid}px grid.

panelNoteThemeInflates.message: The token dictionary came from the page's own theme, which generates a dense ladder of sizes. Matching is easier than with a hand-written token set, and the grid check below is not independent evidence.

panelNoteCssInJs.message: This page uses CSS-in-JS, whose output is always a literal value. Whether a value came from a token cannot be told apart from a hardcoded one, so origin is not reported.

panelNoteOriginBudget.message: Collecting origins hit its time budget, so origin is not reported for this measurement.

panelNoteOriginUnavailable.message: No origin could be read (for example the stylesheets are cross-origin), so origin is not reported.

hlNone.message: No visible element uses that value now.

panelHighlightStale.message: These numbers are not from the page you are looking at, so highlighting is off.
